turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that.
You need an answer from me? I'm the one who asked the question, Hale. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went in, yes or no?
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.

"Admits it." I'm writing down that you want a confession from a seventeen-year-old by Friday at 3 PM, and you still haven't told me whether anyone heard him before that zero went in. Your own procedure, 4.2, says you call me before any mark is entered, so I'm walking into the principal's office the minute I leave this room.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
Neither. You've given me two options and your own procedure gives me a third, which is the principal reviewing your decision under 4.6. What do you have besides that checker, Hale?
